title: Slot wider than the tool leaves up to 0.86 mm in its round ends, and verify is ok

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What

A Slot with a width larger than the tool diameter leaves material in its two round ends. `verify` reports no problem, and the post is not blocked.

The work on the example case `2d/slots` (#2861, part of #2392) found this.

## How to reproduce

On `main` at `ab9955105`, run this script with a model `slots` (a 100 x 60 x 12 mm block, stock of the same size):

```js
cam.call("add_tool", { catalog: "EM-0600-4FL", holder: "none" });
cam.call("add_operation", {
  kind: "Slot", name: "Slot1", tool: "EM-0600-4FL", source: "slots",
  params: {
    a: [-25.0, 15.0], b: [25.0, 15.0], width: 10.0, stock_to_leave: 0.0,
    top_z: { reference: "top_of_stock", offset: 0.0 },
    bottom_z: { reference: "top_of_stock", offset: -6.0 },
    stepdown: 3.0, stepover: 2.0, feed: 600.0, plunge_feed: 150.0, climb: true
  }
});
cam.generate();
cam.verify();   // ok
```

## What the program does

The tool is 6 mm and the slot is 10 mm wide. The tool centre must stay in a stadium of 2 mm radius around the line `a -> b`. Each level posts three rows:

```
G01 X-25. Y13. Z9. F150
G01 X25. Y13. Z9. F600
G01 X27. Y15. Z9. F600
G01 X-27. Y15. Z9. F600
G01 X-25. Y17. Z9. F600
G01 X25. Y17. Z9. F600
```

The rows touch the round end only at their end points. The tool does not follow the arc between two row ends. The move between two rows is a straight line (a chord), not an arc.

## Measured

A point check of the 10 mm stadium against the tool centre path gives these results:

- The largest leftover is 0.86 mm, on the wall of each round end at 45 degrees, where no move joins two rows.
- The leftover is 0.59 mm at the two corners where a chord joins two rows.
- The total area that is not cut is about 8.9 mm2 for each level.

The straight walls are correct. The rows at `Y13` and `Y17` cut them to size.

## Expected

One of these:

- The Slot cuts its full outline. For example, the tool follows the two half circles of the tool centre stadium at each level.
- The operation reports the leftover as a warning that names the Slot and the largest leftover.

## Workaround

- Use a smaller `stepover`. The leftover becomes smaller, but it does not go to zero.
- Use a Trochoidal slot of the same width. Its last move is a half circle around `b`, and its entry is a full circle around `a`.

## Notes

- The row law is in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slots.rs` (`SlotParams`: "each row reaches the round ends exactly as far as it can").
- The case `examples/catalog/2d/slots` shows the two programs side by side. A fix changes `slots.nc` of that case. Run `cargo xtask catalog --case 2d/slots` with the fix.
